name: Posidonius
biography: Syrian Greek eclectic philosopher, historian, and scientist (estimated the sun's distance more accurately than any other ancient, foreshadowing Columbus's confidence in a westward route), taught Cicero at Rhodes; revived Platonic/Orphic ideas about the soul's survival among the stars and about degrees of post-mortem purity, arguably paving the way, in Bevan's view Russell cites, for Gnosticism.
